limitations: This source is a narrative clinical review, not a primary study. Trial outcomes are tagged secondary_reported_result and remain attributed to this review.
The extraction prioritizes independently reviewable diagnostic, risk-stratification, treatment, safety, supportive-care, and smoldering-myeloma assertions; it does not atomize the bibliography.
